60/S0.subgoal: Frame the lecture's aim to move from theoretical XR concepts to implementation-level system development.

60/S1.subgoal: Explain how the lecture focuses on coding and implementation and introduce Unity as a cross-platform environment intended to abstract the graphics pipeline.

60/S2.subgoal: Explain how Unity Hub installs and manages the Unity editor and game engine.
